Spotlight
Big news from our friends at @DeFiSaver [ https://substack.com/redirect/dce89a57-5f8b-4216-bb00-82559364cce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] - who just announced their new Liquidation Protection feature! 
As stated in their thread below:
“Today we are introducing Liquidation Protection.
A minimal automation option that we believe every lending protocol user should enable to avoid liquidation penalties at all times.
Available now across all of the top DeFi protocols...
Liquidation Protection does one thing and one thing only: 
It monitors your position 24/7 and if its health drops too low, it makes an instant automated adjustment where it uses a small part of your collateral to clear part of your debt. 
Given that all the lending protocols in DeFi today work with overcollateralised loans, this will always result in an increased health factor of your position…”
This upgrade builds upon technology and capabilities that already existed within DeFi Saver, and makes the Liquidation Protection mechanism extremely robust and easy to view and engage with within the DeFi Saver UX!
Once again… DeFi Saver [ https://substack.com/redirect/b2174655-d618-4e24-b064-b9f914677fba?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is a trustless, non-custodial protocol aggregator that allows for efficient defi position management. It integrates all the major defi greats such as Aave V3 and V4, Morpho, Euler, Compound, Spark, Sky, and others - all in one intuitive UI, and offers advanced tools catering to more experienced users!
In addition, if you missed their recent update about their extremely cool new tool called tokensaver.fyi [ https://substack.com/redirect/3ac1a639-bc60-4b53-8b76-9a060f0d5dc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], make sure to check it out here [ https://substack.com/redirect/27829870-1828-447e-9665-6a443b03f25b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]!
And as always make sure to follow them on Twitter [ https://substack.com/redirect/dce89a57-5f8b-4216-bb00-82559364cce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for more updates, and stay tuned as we continue bringing updates on everything they are shipping!

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Daniel Kuhn

Presented by:

( https://www.bitget.com/campaigns/project-archimedes?channelCode=regd&vipCode=bw1d&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday 🎉 First things first, don't miss today's interview with *Tether* CEO *Paolo Ardoino* on The Starting Block ( https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2088293346624077835?s=20&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) , unpacking the stablecoin giant's landmark *KPMG* U.S. audit, from gold bars and *bitcoin* reserves to its $6 billion in excess equity.

In today's newsletter, *Strategy* and *Metaplanet* could face *MSCI* index removal, a *Washington* state court orders *Kalshi* to halt most of its prediction market offerings, *Payward* posts $508 million in Q2 adjusted revenue, and more.

Meanwhile, *Citigroup* CEO *Jane Fraser* said she would like to see landmark cryptocurrency legislation ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-13-citigroup-ceo-fraser-on-clarity-act-we-would-like-to-see-good-bill-go-stablecoin-reward-issues-simmer-411751?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) passed into law, as stablecoin reward issues continue to simmer.

*👀 P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *MSCI* later in the newsletter.

*⛰️ Reminder:* We'll be on the ground at *SALT's Blockchain Symposium* ( https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2087204548247183396?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) in Jackson Hole Aug. 17-20, with exclusive interviews and coverage of the biggest stories shaping crypto and global finance.

*THE BIG ONE*

*😬 Strategy, Metaplanet could face MSCI index removal under new proposal*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-14-strategy-metaplanet-msci-index-proposal-411809?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*MSCI* proposed a new eligibility screen for non-operating companies that could see *Strategy* and *Metaplanet* removed from its Global Investable Market Indexes.

* According to a new consultation paper, an MSCI simulation using May 2026 data showed Strategy, Metaplanet, and uranium investment firm Yellow Cake would be deleted from the MSCI ACWI IMI under the framework, with *Sharplink* and two non-crypto firms placed on a watchlist.
* The screening tests whether a company holds sufficient operating assets, then evaluates them against five financial ratios

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk appetite drained as sticky inflation and $82 oil pushed Bitcoin under $63,000, with spot ETFs bleeding two straight days. Washington deepened the gloom — yet Wall Street and Israeli banks kept building. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $63K as Inflation Data Disappoints and ETFs Post First Two-Day Drawdown of August Bitcoin wiped out last week's gains and slid under $63,000 after U.S. inflation figures failed to deliver the dovish surprise traders wanted, while WTI crude topping $82 a barrel and rising bond yields squeezed risk assets broadly. Spot bitcoin ETFs recorded back-to-back outflows for the first time since late July, and altcoins found no direction of their own — XRP is now teetering around the $1 mark. The regulator had been ready to release at least part of a long-awaited "innovation exemption" for tokenization alongside it; that too is now delayed amid pushback from Wall Street and the White House. A clean opinion on the reserves behind roughly $180 billion of USDT removes one of the longest-standing question marks hanging over the crypto market's core settlement asset. 77495.body:
The Atlas

Автор: GenAI Works

Welcome back! This edition covers ChatGPT moving onto your screen, Google cutting prices at a billion users, the actual math behind going viral on X and a wallet built for software.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: How close is too close? OpenAI shipped three things in one week: ChatGPT now watches your computer, opens your Drive files and answers 14x faster. Why is the winner cutting prices? Gemini hit 1 billion users faster than any Google product ever, then Google halved the price of its newest Flash model two days later. What is a like actually worth? X open-sourced its ranking algorithm, and the copy-link share turns out to be worth 40 likes while your reposts are worth 2. Would you give your agent $10? Cloudflare launched Wallets so agents can finally pay for APIs themselves, with spending caps that make the autonomy safe. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. ChatGPT got closer to you All three do the same thing: put less distance between you and the model. Computer History lets ChatGPT watch everything you do on your computer.  It learns how you work, picks up tasks you left half-finished and suggests automations based on your real habits.  Sam Altman told a room of interns last week that an assistant with this much context was six months away.  The first piece arrived in one. Google Drive inside ChatGPT ends the tab switching.  Docs, Sheets and Slides open in a side panel.  Rolling out on the web to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise. Ultrafast runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster, at 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras and starting in the API.  Fast used to mean switching to a smaller model. Now it doesn't. That speed opens new jobs.   → OpenAI's engineers read logs and traces while an outage is still happening  → Research that ran overnight now finishes in an afternoon  → Support agents solve multi-step problems without the pause that loses the call So the assistant sees your screen, sits with your files and keeps up with your conversation. What about the security part? Computer History raises the risk of prompt injection.  Visit a website with hidden malicious instructions and ChatGPT or Codex may follow them.  The more your assistant reads, the more places an attacker can leave a note for it. Your team lives in Cursor and Claude.
